positions.title: Accounting Assistant
positions.description:
•	Specialized in QuickBooks administration, managing users’ rolls and right levels, customizing data layouts, all while maintaining data security
•	Account Receivable, Account Payable, Purchase order, and Bank reconciliations.
•	Experienced with tracking and auditing company payments ranging from $15,000 to $40,000 per month.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
•	Network maintenance by performing network monitoring and analysis, performance tuning, and troubleshooting network problems.
•	Establish network specifications by analyzing workflow, information, and security requirements; designing router administration, including interface configuration, routing protocols, and conferring with users.
•	Secured the network by developing network access, monitoring, control, evaluation, and maintaining documentation.
•	Resolved network performance issues including availability, utilization, throughput, good put, and latency; planning and executing the selection, installation, configuration, and testing of equipment; defining network policies and procedures; establishing connections and firewalls.
•	Created the company’s website displaying company and product information.
